{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= Respawn

|descr= Camera script used by the "group respawn" template - when the player dies and gets transferred to the new group member.

|s1= [oldUnit, newUnit] call [[BIS_fnc_respawnGroup]]

|p1= oldUnit: [[Object]]

|p2= newUnit: [[Object]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>
// in onPlayerRespawn.sqf
params ["_newUnit", "_oldUnit", "_respawn", "_respawnDelay"];
[_oldUnit, _newUnit] spawn BIS_fnc_respawnGroup;
</sqf>

|exec= spawn
